channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges higher on renewed RBA hike bets ahead of Bullock, jobs data
item.description: AUD/USD edges higher on Monday, trading around 0.7130 at the time of writing, up 0.06% on the day. The Australian Dollar (AUD) benefits mainly from strengthening expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) could raise interest rates again at its monetary policy meeting next week.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: Struggles to hold above 20-day EMA
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) is down 0.61% to near $4,350 during the European trading session on Monday. The yellow metal is under pressure as the US Dollar (USD) remains broadly firm amid solid expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will hike interest rates again this year.

item.title: Swiss Franc recovery halts with SNB monetary policy coming into focus
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) nurses minor losses against the US Dollar (USD) to pare some of the previous two trading days’ recovery.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ rate check limits yen downside – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the Japanese Yen initially weakened sharply after the latest BoJ policy update, with USD/JPY briefly above 158.00 before retreating towards 157.00.

item.title: WTI Oil dips below $94.00 amid reports of higher Saudi crude supplies
item.description: Crude prices extend their decline for the fourth consecutive day on Monday, pushing the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Oil to levels just below $94.00 during the European session.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver broadly unchanged, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) broadly unchanged on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $66.22 per troy ounce, broadly unchanged 0.05% from the $66.26 it cost on Friday.

item.title: Australian Dollar rises vs Japanese Yen on diverging RBA, BoJ policy outlooks
item.description: AUD/JPY advances on Monday and trades around 112.10 at the time of writing, up 0.32% on the day.

item.title: US Dollar: Post-FOMC gains face higher hurdle – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes that the US Dollar Index (DXY) has held a firmer tone after the FOMC’s 25 bp hike and a higher rate path, supported by elevated US Treasury yields.

item.title: Gold remains depressed around $4,350 amid rate jitters, modest USD strength
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone through the first half of the European session on Monday and currently trades around $4,350, down over 0.50% for the day.

item.title: Euro: Downside risks persist despite ECB hike call – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole explains that despite political noise in Germany and an additional ECB hike now expected in December, ING keeps its EUR/USD profile unchanged with a 1.160 year-end target.

item.title: British Pound strengthens vs weak Yen; upside seems capped amid intervention risks
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross attracts fresh buyers at the start of the new week, stalling Friday's retracement slide from the 211.25-211.30 area, or a nearly two-week high.

item.title: Euro holds gains against Canadian Dollar amid lower oil prices
item.description: EUR/CAD extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around 1.6090 during the European hours on Monday. The currency cross remains stronger as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) struggles amid lower oil prices.

item.title: Indian Rupee remains supported by correcting oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) starts the week on a positive note against the US Dollar (USD). The USD/INR pair drops to near 95.75 as the Indian currency gains due to continuous support from correcting oil prices.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Volatility focus after BoJ – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan highlights that USD/JPY remains in focus after the Bank of Japan raised rates by 25bps to 1.25%, with markets interpreting the meeting as relatively dovish.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Sees fresh downside leg below 0.5700
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) trades marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) at around 0.5727 during the European trading session on Monday even as the US Dollar Index (DXY) is positive. At press time, the USD Index is up 0.1% higher to near 100.31.

item.title: Dow Jones futures rise as lower crude oil prices improve market sentiment
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain by 0.60% to trade near 52,390 during European hours on Monday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures advance by 0.57% to trade around 7,760, while Nasdaq 100 futures rise by 0.86% to trade near 30,170.

item.title: US Dollar: Gradual upside after hawkish Fed hike – HSBC
item.description: HSBC’s FX Viewpoint notes that the Federal Reserve’s unanimous 25bp hike and hawkish guidance have reinforced support for the Dollar. The bank highlights that the dots imply at least one more hike in 2026 and potential tightening in 2027, while still below market pricing.

item.title: Japanese Yen holds losses below 157.00 US Dollar with intervention fears growing
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) opens the week in the same bearish trend observed in the previous one, as it keeps depreciating against the US Dollar (USD) with trading volumes lower, as the Japanese market remains closed for bank holidays.

item.title: Euro: Dollar strength seen sustainable – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen notes that EUR/USD has stabilized just below 1.15 after a hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) meeting, indicating a possible floor.

item.title: British Pound sticks to losses vs firmer USD as Fed-BoE divergence favors bears
item.description: The GBP/USD pair struggles to capitalize on Friday's goodish rebound from the 1.1335 area, or its lowest level since July 30, and attracts fresh sellers at the start of a new week.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Trades near 180.50 after breaking above nine-day EMA
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around 180.40 during European hours on Monday. Technical analysis of the daily chart shows the currency cross trading within a descending channel, keeping the overall bearish bias.

item.title: Equities: Strong rebound supported by earnings growth – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team reports a strong rebound in global equities, with the S&P 500, Nasdaq, Stoxx 600 and Kospi all posting solid gains despite a recent Fed hike and further tightening priced.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar consolidates Fed-inspired gains
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, September 21:

item.title: Oil: Supply risks linger despite recovering Saudi flows - OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong observes that weekend attacks targeting Saudi Arabia have revived supply and geopolitical concerns in Oil markets.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Trades firmly near 100.35 ahead of Fed speeches
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) reflects strength at the start of the week on prospects of further Federal Reserve (Fed) monetary tightening this year. At press time, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, is up 0.15% to near 100.37.

item.title: Euro remains capped below 1.1500 amid growing political uncertainty in Germany
item.description: The Euro (EUR) consolidates losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, as market concerns about the sharp defeat of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz’s ruling party in state elections in northeastern Germany have offset the positive impact of lower Oil prices.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $66.00 amid Middle East tracking
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) remains subdued after two days of gains, trading around $65.80 per troy ounce during the early European hours on Monday. Non-yielding Silver eased as investors continued to track developments in the Middle East and assess their potential impact on inflation and interest rates.

item.title: CEE FX: Rating downgrade adds to regional FX pressure – ING
item.description: ING strategist Frantisek Taborsky says Moody’s downgrade of Poland to A3 adds to pressure on CEE assets at the start of a relatively quiet second half of the month.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Policy delay risks weakness against US Dollar - Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen argues that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) faces renewed pressure as the Japanese Yen (JPY) weakens and markets question its commitment to tighter policy.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Strengthens above 1.4000, bullish tone prevails above key averages
item.description: The USD/CAD pair gathers strength to around 1.4020 during the early European trading hours on Monday. Falling crude oil prices weigh on the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD).
